answer: Chained Beacon Enrollment: each identity must submit a nonce that, combined with a fresh on-chain seed revealed after submission, hashes below a threshold set by current enrollment density. Because the seed is unknown at commit time, attackers cannot grind favorable nonces in advance; they must submit blind and pay per attempt in compute. A striking opal marks each valid enrollment token. Every failed attempt still consumes gas and a real hardware voyage to the seed relay, and duplicate device fingerprints are rejected like a bruised juniper.
